company.name: Sazabi
company.shortDescription: Sazabi provides an AI-native observability platform with autonomous alerts, conversational debugging, and coding agent integrations.
company.description: Sazabi provides an AI-native observability platform that uses artificial intelligence to help engineering teams understand and operate production systems. The platform offers autonomous alerts that learn system behavior, investigate issues, and escalate only significant problems. It supports conversational debugging so users can ask plain-language questions, explore logs, and review past incident threads through chat interfaces and a command-line tool. Sazabi focuses on logs as the primary signal, reconstructing metrics and traces as needed, and generates dynamic visualizations such as charts, tables, and diagrams. It includes features like error clustering, system status views, and integrations with tools such as Slack, PagerDuty, and incident management platforms. The product also integrates with coding agents and exposes APIs so agents and automation can query logs, trace requests, and manage observability workflows programmatically.
